name: CBIT Internet
summary: Canberra dialup/TransACT/ADSL2+ + hosting + business IT ISP (CBIT Internet Pty Ltd, 16/65 Tennant St Fyshwick); absorbed Bandwidth Unlimited (2005) and merged with Spitfire Internet Services (2 Feb 2009); ISP wound down, later CBIT Business IT Solutions.

events.details: ISP wound down; pivoted to IT consultancy.
